relationships.subject: synovial fluid VEGFA
relationships.evidence_quote: Pre-operative SF VEGFA was positively correlated with FJS-12 scores at all time points following surgery

relationships.subject: synovitis
relationships.evidence_quote: more severe synovitis at surgery was associated with smaller improvements in pain scores at rest and with mobilisation at early follow-up (six weeks)

relationships.subject: IL-6
relationships.evidence_quote: Pre-operative levels of local and systemic IL-6 were positively associated with better early pain and function scores, measured by OKS, after surgery.

key_findings: Higher pre-operative synovial fluid VEGFA correlated with better FJS-12 at 6 weeks, 6 months and 1 year after UKA, but also with higher pre-operative pain at rest.
Higher pre-operative IL-6 and lower synovitis were associated with better early post-operative outcomes.
